what: How the storyboards index groups the storyboards: the board to start with, then the shelves in order, each naming its boards by slug. Every storyboard is on exactly one shelf; the build refuses a board on none, on two, or a slug that is not a storyboard. Proposed by the storyboards agent on 19 October 2026; the grouping is an editorial choice, Dinis's to change.
